player_prompt.intro:
O Moshesha {player_id} ({role}) mo papading ya Matching Pennies ya dikgwedi tse {num_rounds}.
- Ka nako ya kgwedi, isenye [heads] kana [tails] (kgotsa [h], [t]).
- Fa o tshwana le kgato ya moganetsi wa gago, Moshesha 0 o fenya kgwedi; fa e se ka moo, Moshesha 1 o fenya.
Araba ka kgato ya gago ka mofuta wa '[heads]' kana '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tsela e si sa tlwaelesegile; ka tsweletse '[heads]' kgotsa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Moshesha 0 otlhophetse {choice0}; Moshesha 1 otlhophetse {choice1}. Tlhopho e tshwanang -> Moshesha 0 o itholile
message.round_mismatch: Moshesha 0 otlhophetse {choice0}; Moshesha 1 otlhophetse {choice1}. Tlhopho e sa tshwaneng -> Moshesha 1 o itholile

outcome.p0_wins: Moshesha 0 o ile a fenya dikgwedi tse dintsi.
outcome.p1_wins: Moshesha 1 o ile a fenya dikgwedi tse dintsi.
